Orthogonal PLQR moment contributions for a given \(\beta\) (oracle nuisances)

plqr_moment.Rd

Computes, for each observation \(i\), the orthogonal PLQR moment $$ (\tau - \mathbf{1}\{\,Y_{i} \le D_{i}^{\top}\beta + q_{\tau}(X_{i})\,\})\, (D_{i} - m_{D}(X_{i})) \, , $$ where \(m_{D}(X) = \mathbb{E}[D \mid X]\) is provided as an oracle nuisance. This is the vector moment entering the Z-estimation.

Usage

plqr_moment(df, beta, tau)

Arguments

df

A data.frame as returned by plqr_demo_data()$data, containing columns Y, D1..Dp_d, oracle nuisances mD1..mDp_d, and q_oracle.

beta

Numeric length-p_d coefficient vector \(\beta\).

tau

Quantile level \(\tau\) (should match the data-generating level).

Value

A numeric matrix of size \(n \times p_d\).

Examples

demo <- plqr_demo_data(n = 100, p = 2, p_d = 2, tau = 0.5, seed = 1)
plqr_moment(demo$data, beta = demo$truth$beta_true, tau = 0.5)
